Key Responsibilities Switch Operations, Administration & Security • Configure, re-configure, and optimize L2 and L3 switches across the campus. • Create, modify, and delete VLANs; manage user access ports and network connectivity requirements. • Configure Switch Virtual Interfaces (SVI), virtual ports, trunk ports, port channels, and link aggregation. • Configure and maintain Layer-3 routing services. • Configure and manage High Availability (HA) — switch stacking, virtual chassis, HSRP, VRRP, or equivalent technologies. • Perform periodic security scanning of all switches (L2 & L3) and remediate identified vulnerabilities in a timely manner. Monitoring & Preventive Maintenance • Continuously monitor and administer network switches. • Conduct monthly health checks covering hardware status, CPU and memory utilization, power supplies, fans, uplinks, interfaces, and system logs. • Perform preventive maintenance to ensure optimum performance and availability. • Take and maintain configuration backups; perform restoration when required. • Support firmware/software review and upgrades, wherever applicable and approved by the client. Fault Management & Troubleshooting • Diagnose and resolve switch-related hardware, software, configuration, and connectivity issues. • Troubleshoot VLAN, routing, uplink, trunk, port channel, and network performance issues. • Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and recommend corrective actions for major incidents. • Troubleshoot LAN connectivity issues affecting end users, printers, servers, wireless devices, IP CCTV, biometric systems, and other IoT/network-connected devices. LAN & Fiber Connectivity Support • Test and troubleshoot LAN and fiber connectivity. • Identify faulty cables, patch cords, I/O points, patch panels, and switch ports. • Verify network point connectivity and cable continuity. • Coordinate with designated cabling service providers to rectify physical cabling faults. OEM Coordination & RMA Support • Log and manage complaints with OEMs for faulty switches and hardware components. • Coordinate with OEM support teams for diagnosis, troubleshooting, and replacement. • Initiate, track, and close RMA (Return Material Authorization) cases. • Install, configure, and test replacement hardware, including bringing up affected networks using standby switches. Remote & Onsite Support • Provide remote support via phone, email, remote access tools, or ticketing systems. • Support configuration changes, troubleshooting, and incident resolution. • Provide on-demand remote assistance during business hours and emergency support for critical incidents. • Conduct at least one preventive maintenance visit per month for physical inspection and health verification of all switches. • Visit the client campus whenever a switch is inaccessible remotely, network services are disrupted, or physical intervention is required — and remain onsite until normal operations are restored. Documentation & Reporting • Maintain updated switch configurations and network documentation. • Prepare and submit monthly service reports covering health-check status, incidents handled, configuration changes, OEM/RMA status, and recommendations/observations. • Maintain incident and RCA reports for major outages and configuration backup records. Required Technical Skills • Strong hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise L2/L3 switches in a campus/LAN environment. • Practical, multi-vendor exposure to Juniper (EX-2300 / EX-4200 / EX-4300), Aruba, Cisco, HPE, Huawei and Netgear switches (managed and unmanaged). • Solid working knowledge of VLANs, trunking, STP/RSTP, link aggregation (LACP), SVIs, and port channels. • Layer-3 routing fundamentals (static and dynamic routing) and first-hop redundancy (HSRP / VRRP). • Switch stacking / virtual chassis and other High Availability configurations. • Switch security hardening and vulnerability scanning/remediation. • Structured cabling awareness — fiber and copper LAN, patch panels, I/O points, and cable fault isolation. • Familiarity with monitoring tools, configuration backup/restore, and firmware upgrade practices. • Experience with OEM/RMA processes and coordinating vendor hardware replacements. • Comfortable troubleshooting connectivity for end-user devices, IP CCTV, biometric and IoT endpoints. Qualifications & Certifications • Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related field. • 3–6 years of relevant experience in network switching support/AMC operations. • Preferred certifications: CCNA / JNCIA / Aruba ACSA (or equivalent); higher certifications (CCNP / JNCIS) are an advantage. Soft Skills & Attributes • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with an SLA-driven, ownership mindset. • Clear written and verbal communication for reporting, coordination, and RCA documentation. • Ability to work independently onsite and coordinate with OEMs, cabling vendors, and client stakeholders. • Willingness to provide onsite support and respond to critical/emergency incidents as required. • Attention to detail in documentation, configuration management, and change control. Working Conditions • Primarily onsite at the school campus in Noida, with remote support responsibilities. • Availability for emergency/critical-incident support outside standard business hours as per SLA. • At least one scheduled preventive maintenance visit per month, plus onsite visits on demand.
